log.entry: Rotor R-12 inspected, no cracks. Cleared for 5000 rpm.
Operator reported mild vibration above 3500 rpm at the end of a run; rebalanced tubes, vibration stopped.
Second vibration report at 4200 rpm. Run aborted by imbalance sensor. Left in service pending review.
Cycle 4 ended with error E-31 (pressure not held). Cleared by restart.
Alarm panel shows -71C after door was left ajar overnight. Setpoint -80C. Contents: patient-derived cell lines and antibody aliquots.
Wavelength accuracy check passed with holmium filter.
